name: Smooth blend
description: The classic long DJ blend. The next song is beat-matched and slides in underneath while the current one fades away, so for a while you hear both playing in time. The new song's bass is held back until partway through and then takes over from the old bass within one bar, so the two basslines never pile up, and the old song's treble is gently dipped as it leaves. Works best between songs with steady beats, similar tempos and keys that get along.
author: Muisc

len.label: Length
len.doc: How many bars both songs play together

bassPoint.label: Bass handover
bassPoint.doc: How far into the blend the new song's bass takes over (0.5 = halfway)

bassCut.label: Bass cut
bassCut.doc: How far the bass that is not leading is turned down

highDip.label: Treble dip
highDip.doc: How far the old song's treble is dipped as it leaves
